name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.
author: Almmatix

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.1.1.

Clean up parties removed from Tally: if you created a party in Tally and later deleted it, open Status and press "Clean up parties removed from Tally". After a confirmation, any customer no longer in your Tally is hidden and stops getting reminders. Nothing is deleted - their history is kept, and they come back automatically if they return to Tally.

Also includes the 2.1.0 fixes: recording a payment by hand always works, Tally no longer crashes if you open it after ASVA, your reminder selections and search are never wiped by a background sync, Tally payments show correctly on the customer page, and a new "Name A to Z (owing only)" filter.

Free for every shop until 30 September 2026.
